name: Skeletal Metastases to Long Bones
definition: Metastatic cancer deposits in long bones causing pain, cortical destruction and risk of impending or completed pathological fracture.

investigations.principle: Radiographs of the entire bone, CT/MRI and systemic staging guide management; fracture-risk scoring may assist.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Protect weight bearing when fracture risk is high
amber: Prophylactic fixation may be preferable to waiting for a complete fracture in selected high-risk lesions.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-vikara phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Metastatic cancer deposits in long bones causing pain, cortical destruction and risk of impending or completed pathological fracture.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
